goods.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like three boxes in a stack: one on top and two side by side below. A stack of boxes like that at a shop is full of <radical form="品">goods</radical>.
goods.image_prompt: Outside the back door of a shop, three square cardboard crates are stacked: one on top, two side by side below it. A delivery worker leans on the stack, checking a list. The boxes are full of <radical>goods</radical> for sale.

grove.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like two trees standing close together, their branches touching. Two trees that close make a small <radical form="林">grove</radical>.
grove.image_prompt: Two brown trees stand side by side, each with a straight trunk, spreading roots and a few green leaves. They stand so close that the right branch of the left tree touches the left branch of the right tree. Together they are a small <radical>grove</radical>.

gyouninben.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a tall stair rail with two short steps sticking out. The rail is always on the left side of a kanji. It is the <radical form="彳">step (left)</radical>.

gyouninben.description: This shape only ever appears down the left-hand side of a kanji, never on the right and never on its own, which is why the meaning we teach names that position.

haba.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a hook on a wall with fabric hanging over it. The fabric falls down in two long folds. It is a piece of <radical form="巾">cloth</radical>.
haba.image_prompt: A hook nailed into a wall. Over the top bar hangs a rectangle of fabric, falling down in two long folds on each side. A straight line runs down the middle to the floor. It is a limp, hanging piece of <radical>cloth</radical>.

hachigashira.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a log split by an axe. The two strokes are the halves falling apart. The shape means split, and also <radical form="八">eight</radical>.
hachigashira.image_prompt: A single log stands on a chopping block just after an axe has come down on it. The two halves fall apart, leaning away from each other, with a clean gap at the top where the blade split them. The fresh split marks <radical>eight</radical>.
hachigashira.description: 八 and 人 are the same two falling strokes, apart or joined. 八 keeps them separate, both leaning away from a gap at the top. 人 brings them together into a single sharp peak. An open top means 八.

haha.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a woman holding two small children, one under each arm. The two dots are the children. She is <radical form="母">mother</radical>.
haha.image_prompt: A seated woman, her body a leaning frame. Two small children sit inside the frame, one under each arm, shown as two dots. A long line crosses the middle as her arms folded to hold them close. She is <radical>mother</radical>.

hakogamae.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a box with a top, a bottom and a left wall, but no right side. The open side faces you. It is a <radical form="匚">box on its side</radical>.
hakogamae.image_prompt: A wooden box tipped over so it lies on its side. Its top, bottom and left wall are visible, and the open right side faces the viewer. A hand slides a small parcel straight into it. It is a <radical>box on its side</radical>.

halberd.mnemonic_text: This radical is a combination of <part form="予">beforehand</part> and <part form="丿">slash</part>. A guard hooks a blade on top <part form="予">beforehand</part>, then a long shaft makes a <part form="丿">slash</part> down: a <radical form="矛">halberd</radical>.
halberd.image_prompt: A guard at a castle gate holds a long weapon. At the top is a curled, hooked blade he fixed on earlier. Below it one long wooden shaft sweeps down and away at an angle, as if in the middle of a thrust. The weapon is a <radical>halberd</radical>.

hane.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like two matching feathers side by side. A duck cleans itself too hard, and two feathers pop off. Each one is a <radical form="羽">feather</radical>.
hane.image_prompt: A surprised duck by a pond pulls too hard while cleaning itself. Two matching feathers pop loose and float down side by side, each with small hooked lines on one center line. Each one is a <radical>feather</radical>.

hashiru-run.mnemonic_text: This radical combines <part form="土">earth</part> and <part form="止">stop</part>. Loose <part form="土">earth</part> flies up at the top. Below it, a pair of legs will not <part form="止">stop</part>. They <radical form="走">run</radical>.

hatsugashira.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a runner who slips and falls into the splits. His arms fly out and his legs slide far apart. Ouch! Those are <radical form="癶">outspread legs</radical>.

head.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a round head wearing a flat helmet. The head has a big chin and sits alone on a line. It rolled off a shelf. It is just a <radical form="疋">head</radical>.

hito.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like two legs walking: one leg stands still and the other steps forward. Two slanting lines make one walking <radical form="人">person</radical>.

hitoashi.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a person standing with their feet apart. The two strokes sweep down and out, like a pair of <radical form="儿">human legs</radical>.

hitsuji.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like an animal seen from the front. The two short strokes on top are horns, and the lines below are its stiff legs. It stands calmly and chews: a <radical form="羊">sheep</radical>.

hiyominotori.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a jar with a lid on top and a line across its middle. The line shows how much drink is left. It is a <radical form="酉">sake jar</radical>.

hoko.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a long weapon leaning against a gate. It has a curved blade, and a guard's scarf is caught on the tip. The guard walks away, and down falls the <radical form="戈">halberd</radical>.
hoko.image_prompt: A long wooden shaft leans on a castle gate at a steep diagonal. A curved blade hooks off the side of the shaft. A guard walks past, his scarf snags on the tip at the top, pulls tight, and the whole weapon topples with a crash: a <radical>halberd</radical>.

holy.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a hand laid flat on the ground. The hand blesses the plain soil under it. Now that ground is <radical form="圣">holy</radical>.
holy.image_prompt: A large open hand at the top presses flat onto a patch of plain brown soil at the bottom. Soft light shines where the hand touches, and a small flower starts to grow there. The ground is now <radical>holy</radical>.

horns.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like two short lines on top of a small goat's head, leaning apart. The goat headbutts a post with its two little <radical form="丷">horns</radical>.

husband.image_prompt: A big man stands with arms and legs spread wide. One long pin runs straight across through his hair, just above his head. He stands proudly at his wedding, the pin showing he is now a <radical>husband</radical>.

i.image_prompt: A squat robot facing forward. The top is a flat plate on its head; its middle has criss-cross wiring; at the bottom is a big square speaker-grille mouth. ichi.mnemonic_text: This radical is one flat line lying on the floor. One line, lying as flat as the <radical form="一">ground</radical>.
ichi.image_prompt: A single long, flat horizontal line lies straight across the floor of a plain room, perfectly level from left to right, with nothing above or below it. It is one line, lying as flat as the <radical>ground</radical>.

inoko.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like an animal lying on its back. Its four short legs kick in the air, and the little hook is a curly tail. It is an angry <radical form="豕">pig</radical>.
inoko.image_prompt: An animal has been flipped onto its back for a belly rub. Its four short legs shoot straight up and kick at the air, and a small hooked stroke at the back curls into one tight tail. Its face looks offended. It is a very unhappy <radical>pig</radical>.

inu.mnemonic_text: This radical is a combination of <part form="大">big</part> and <part form="丶">drop</part>. A <part form="大">big</part> animal has a <part form="丶">drop</part> on its shoulder. It spins and snaps at it, like any <radical form="犬">dog</radical>.
inu.image_prompt: A big, happy animal stands with its legs spread wide. A single small dot sits high up by its shoulder. The animal spins in a tight circle, snapping at that spot again and again and never reaching it, just like a <radical>dog</radical> chasing its tail.
inu.description: 大 (big) is just the figure with arms out, no extra mark anywhere. 太 (thick / fat) adds its dot low down, between the legs, like a belly bulge. 犬 adds its dot high up, by the shoulder, like the flea it keeps snapping at — the dot's height is the only difference between all three.

ireru.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a person leaning forward, one leg stepping ahead of the other, as they duck under a low doorway. They are about to <radical form="入">enter</radical>.
ireru.image_prompt: A person leans forward mid-stride, one leg swinging ahead of the other, ducking their head under a very low doorway. Their body forms the two strokes of the shape. They are just about to step inside and <radical>enter</radical>.
ireru.description: 入 and 人 use the same two strokes. In 人 they meet at the very top. In 入 the short left stroke begins partway down the long one, leaving a small overhang above it rather than a point.

ishi.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a small box under a leaning rock wall. It is a big round rock that rolled down and stopped there: one solid <radical form="石">stone</radical>.
ishi.image_prompt: A leaning rock wall on a hillside, with its top edge running flat and its left end bending down. At its base sits a boxy, rounded rock that has rolled down the slope and come to rest: one solid <radical>stone</radical>.
ishi.description: 石 and 右 both have a small box under a two-stroke top. In 石 the horizontal comes first and only its left end turns down, so nothing sticks out past the left side. In 右 the falling stroke comes first and the horizontal crosses it, so the bar sticks out on both sides.

itaru.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a dart coming down onto the flat ground at the bottom. It sticks point-first in the floor, still shaking. Watch it <radical form="至">arrive</radical>.
itaru.image_prompt: A dart flies across a room in a slow arc and turns nose-down. Its point sticks into a flat wooden floor, and it stands upright, still shaking. Small motion lines trace the path it took to finally <radical>arrive</radical>.

itohen.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a small spool at the top with one strand twisting down. At the bottom, the loose ends spread out. It is one piece of <radical form="糸">thread</radical>.
itohen.image_prompt: A small wooden spool at the top. One strand winds off it and twists down in two loops. At the bottom, the end frays into three loose fibers spread apart. Plain background, one piece of <radical>thread</radical>.

itoko.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a small loop of thread with its ends hanging down. It is so thin that you have to squint to see it. It is a <radical form="幺">tiny thread</radical>.
itoko.image_prompt: A single small loop of thread pinched at the top and left dangling, its two loose ends trailing off below. It is so thin and fine that a person nearby squints hard to see this <radical>tiny thread</radical>.

iwaku.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a wide open mouth with a flat tongue across the middle. The tongue is moving, pushing out a word. The mouth is about to <radical form="曰">say</radical> something.
iwaku.image_prompt: A wide, squat open mouth seen from the front, wider than it is tall. One flat tongue lies across the middle, moving mid-word. A small speech bubble starts to come out. The mouth is about to <radical>say</radical> something.
iwaku.description: 曰 and 日 are the same box with one bar inside, told apart by proportion. 曰 is squat, wider than it is tall, and its inner bar often stops short of the right wall. 日 is clearly taller than it is wide.

jammed-in.mnemonic_text: This radical combines <part form="人">person</part>, <part form="丿">slash</part> and <part form="丨">stick</part>. A <part form="人">person</part> stands between a thin <part form="丿">slash</part> on the left and a <part form="丨">stick</part> on the right. He cannot move. He is <radical form="介">jammed in</radical>.
jammed-in.image_prompt: A man stands with his arms raised over his head, hands touching like a pointed roof. A thin board on his left and a thin post on his right press tight against his sides, so he cannot turn or step. He is <radical>jammed in</radical>.

jewel.mnemonic_text: This radical combines <part form="王">king</part> and <part form="丶">drop</part>. A <part form="王">king</part> holds one shiny <part form="丶">drop</part> at his side. It is his favourite <radical form="玉">jewel</radical>.
jewel.image_prompt: A proud king in a crown and robe stands in the center. Down at his lower right side he holds one small shiny drop-shaped gem, sparkling in the light, and smiles at it. It is his favourite <radical>jewel</radical>.

juu.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like two matchsticks crossing in the middle, one flat and one standing up. They make a plus sign. This cross means <radical form="十">ten</radical>.
juu.image_prompt: Two wooden matchsticks lie on a table, one flat and one standing straight up, crossing exactly at their middles to make a perfect plus sign. Their red tips point up and to the right. The little cross stands for <radical>ten</radical>.

kai-shell.mnemonic_text: This radical combines <part form="目">eye</part> and <part form="八">eight</part>. A big clam shell with an <part form="目">eye</part> on top tips open, and <part form="八">eight</part> gold coins spill out. Long ago, shells like this were used as <radical form="貝">money</radical>.
kai-shell.image_prompt: A big clam shell with one large cartoon eye on its ridged top stands on two short legs. The shell tips open, and exactly eight shiny gold coins spill out onto the ground below. The eye looks proudly at the coins, because long ago shells were used as <radical>money</radical>.
kai-shell.description: Both stand a box on two legs, and the legs decide it. 貝 finishes with two short straight strokes dropping away like little feet. 見 finishes with a straight left leg and a right leg that curves out and hooks upward.

kakeru.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a tired person slumped sideways in a chair. His mouth is wide open in a big yawn. He does not have the energy to sit up. He shows a <radical form="欠">lack</radical> of energy.
kakeru.image_prompt: A tired person slumped sideways in a chair, the upper body leaning to one side like the top stroke, legs sprawled out below. The mouth is wide open in a huge, jaw-stretching yawn. The person is too worn out to sit up and shows a <radical>lack</radical> of energy.
kakeru.description: 欠 starts with a slash and then a short stroke that bends down like a small roof, then ends in two strokes spreading into a peak. 攵 has a straight, flat bar under its opening slash, with no bend. That bent roof versus the flat bar is the difference.

kanamuri.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like two wooden sticks leaning together. A short one and a long one meet in a sharp point at the top, like an upside-down V. That pointed shape is a <radical form="𠂉">chevron</radical>.
kanamuri.image_prompt: Two plain wooden sticks lean against each other on a blank background. A short stick slants down to the left; a much longer stick slants down to the right and crosses it just below the top. Together they meet in a sharp point, like an upside-down V: a <radical>chevron</radical>.

kanehen.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a little roof with two small nuggets on a stand under it. It is a safe place where you keep your <radical form="金">gold</radical>.
kanehen.image_prompt: A little pointed roof sits at the top. Under it, two tiny shining nuggets rest on a small stand, safe from the rain. It is a covered vault where someone piles up their <radical>gold</radical>.

karai.mnemonic_text: This radical is a combination of <part form="立">stand</part> and <part form="十">ten</part>. A man must <part form="立">stand</part> and eat <part form="十">ten</part> peppers on a skewer. He cries. They are <radical form="辛">spicy</radical>.
karai.image_prompt: A man in a tiny hat stands straight at a food counter. He holds one skewer with ten red peppers stacked on it. His eyes stream, and sweat lifts the hat off his head, but he says nothing here is <radical>spicy</radical>.

katahen.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a signpost at a crossroads, with a lid on top and one arm that swings out and hooks to the side. The arm points the way. It shows you a <radical form="方">direction</radical>.
katahen.image_prompt: A wooden signpost at a crossroads. A flat board lies across the top like a lid. Below, the post has a crossbar and one long arm that swings out and hooks hard to one side, pointing down a road. A traveler stops and looks where it points: a <radical>direction</radical>.

katana.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a curved blade that hooks at the tip. It is stuck in a frozen rice cake, and a small chip has broken off the top. One very sorry <radical form="刀">sword</radical>.
katana.image_prompt: A steel blade with a long stroke that sweeps down and hooks at the tip, standing upright with its tip stuck in a round frozen rice cake. A small chip has broken off the top left of the blade and floats beside it. It is one very embarrassed <radical>sword</radical>.

kawa.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like three long lines of water flowing down side by side. Three streams running together make a <radical form="川">river</radical>.
kawa.image_prompt: Seen from a grassy bank, three long streams of water pour down the picture side by side, the outer two bending gently with the current. The three flowing channels together form one wide <radical>river</radical>.

kawa-skin.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a hand holding a loose flap at the top left. The hand pulls down hard, and the whole <radical form="皮">skin</radical> peels away in one piece.
kawa-skin.image_prompt: A hand grips a loose flap at the top left of an animal hide. Its fingers are braced at the bottom right as it pulls down in one long, steady pull. The hide comes away in a single unbroken sheet, with nothing torn: the <radical>skin</radical>.

keigamae.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a flat roof with two tall walls and no floor. Those three sides make an open <radical form="冂">wide box</radical>.
keigamae.image_prompt: A flat roof with two tall walls dropping straight down from its ends, open at the bottom like a doorway with no floor. The three sides form the top, left and right of a <radical>wide box</radical> that is open toward the ground.
keigamae.description: Three open frames, told apart by their walls. 冂 drops two tall walls from a flat top and leaves the bottom open. 冖 has the same top but only tiny stubs instead of walls. 囗 closes the bottom as well, making a complete square.

keigashira.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a broom head turned on its side. The line on the right is where the handle goes. The three lines are the bristles. It is a <radical form="ヨ">broom</radical>.
keigashira.image_prompt: A broom head turned on its side. The upright on the right is the wooden back where the handle goes in. Three stiff grey bristle rows stick out to the left, dusty from a very long hallway. A well-used <radical>broom</radical>.

kemonohen.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a wild animal seen from the side. It has a pointed nose on top, a curved back, and a leg kicking out. It is ready to run. It is an <radical form="犭">animal</radical>.
kemonohen.image_prompt: A wild fox seen from the side, pressed up against a tall wall on the left. A short flick at the top is its pointed nose, a long curve drops down its back, and one back leg kicks out, ready to run. It is an <radical>animal</radical>.

ki.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a tree. The line going down is the trunk, the flat line is a branch, and the two slanted lines are roots. It is a <radical form="木">tree</radical>.
ki.image_prompt: The vertical stroke is a tree trunk, the horizontal line is a branch spreading out to both sides, and the two slanted strokes sweep down as roots gripping the soil. It is a single <radical>tree</radical> standing in front of you.

kigamae.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like flat layers of mist lying over a hot spring. One wisp curls away to the right. All of it is <radical form="气">steam</radical>.
kigamae.image_prompt: Side view of the air above a hot spring. Flat strokes stacked at the top are layers of vapour lying over the water. The last stroke sweeps out to the right and hooks up where one wisp curls away into the cold air. All of it is <radical>steam</radical>.

kink.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a line that goes straight, then bends sharply back on itself. Something stopped it halfway. That sharp bend is a <radical form="丂">kink</radical>.
kink.image_prompt: One long line starts out straight across the top, then turns down and bends sharply back on itself partway, like a garden hose that got stuck. Water stops flowing at the sharp <radical>kink</radical>.

knife.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a kitchen knife standing straight up on its tip. The short line is its back, and the long hooked line is the sharp edge. It is a <radical form="刂">knife</radical>.
knife.image_prompt: A large chef's knife stands straight up on a wooden cutting board, balanced on its point. A short vertical line on the left is the blunt back; a longer line on the right is the sharp edge, dropping to a small hooked tip. One standing <radical>knife</radical>.

ko.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a small body wrapped in a blanket, with arms thrown wide at the top. It is a <radical form="子">child</radical> running to you for a hug.
ko.image_prompt: The top stroke swings out like two little arms thrown wide, above a body wrapped snugly in a blanket that tapers to a single point below. A bundled-up <radical>child</radical>, arms open, running toward the viewer.

kokoro.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a cartoon heart. The long curved stroke is its round bottom, and the three dots are heartbeats jumping out. It is a beating <radical form="心">heart</radical>.
kokoro.image_prompt: A long curved stroke swings round on the left and tapers to a point at the bottom, forming the lower half of a cartoon heart. Three short dots bounce above it like heartbeats that have not settled yet. The whole shape is a beating <radical>heart</radical>.

kokorohen.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a tall, thin candle with a tiny flame on each side. You light it when you make a wish with your whole <radical form="忄">heart (left)</radical>.
kokorohen.image_prompt: A tall, thin candle stands upright on the left side of the picture. A tiny flame flickers out on each side of the top of the wick. A person with closed eyes makes a wish in front of it, hand on chest: <radical>heart (left)</radical>.
kokorohen.description: Both are three strokes down the left edge. 忄 hangs a short dash on each side of one long vertical. 氵 has no vertical at all — just three separate slanting drops stacked downward.

kome.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like one grain in the middle with husks flying off in every direction, up and down. A farmer has just hit it hard. It is a grain of <radical form="米">rice</radical>.
kome.image_prompt: A single grain sits in the centre while its husks fly off in every direction: the top strokes spray upward, the bottom strokes kick downward. It is bursting apart the moment it is threshed. That little explosion is a grain of <radical>rice</radical>.
kome.description: 来 is 米 with one extra horizontal laid across the top. Count the horizontal strokes: 米 has one, 来 has two.

konzukuri.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like an eye on top of a foot. The eye sees danger ahead, and the foot digs in its heel. It will not take one more step. It is <radical form="艮">stopping</radical>.
konzukuri.image_prompt: A wide-open eye sits at the top. Beneath it, a foot is planted flat on the ground, heel dug in and toes braced. The eye has seen something scary, and the foot refuses to take one more step: it is <radical>stopping</radical> dead.

koromo.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a shirt on a hanger. The small cross on top is the hook, and the wide strokes below are the sleeves and the bottom. It is a piece of <radical form="衣">clothing</radical>.
koromo.image_prompt: A shirt hangs to dry on a clothes line. A small hanger hook sits on top, and the wide sleeves and the bottom of the shirt spread out and hang down below it. A few drops of water fall from the hem of this piece of <radical>clothing</radical>.

koromohen.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a shirt on a hanger. A collar is on top, the body drops down, and a sleeve flaps out and hits the clerk. It is <radical form="衤">clothing (left)</radical>.
koromohen.image_prompt: A shirt on a hanger swings on a spinning dry-cleaner rack. The collar hooks out at the top, the straight body of the shirt drops down, and one sleeve flares sideways and smacks the surprised clerk in the face. It is a piece of <radical>clothing (left)</radical>.

kougatsu.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a steel beam standing between two flat concrete slabs. Workers lower it into place at a <radical form="工">construction</radical> site.
kougatsu.image_prompt: A steel I-beam stands upright between two flat concrete slabs: the top and bottom strokes are the slabs, the line down the middle is the beam being lowered into place by a crane at a busy <radical>construction</radical> site.

kubi.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a face with two hairs on top. The face stretches up to a high shelf on a very long <radical form="首">neck</radical>.
kubi.image_prompt: Two stray hairs stick up over a flat brow, and below them a boxed-in face stretches up toward a high shelf. It is a giraffe in a business suit, and as it stretches, its shirt buttons pop off one by one down its long <radical>neck</radical>.

kuchi.mnemonic_text: This radical is a small square, like a mouth open wide in a big yawn. The four lines are the lips around the open hole. It is a <radical form="口">mouth</radical>.
kuchi.image_prompt: A small, perfect square made of four straight strokes frames a wide-open mouth caught in the middle of a big yawn. The square edges are the lips, and inside is the dark, open hole of the <radical>mouth</radical>.
kuchi.description: 口 and 囗 are drawn the same way, as a closed square. Size and job separate them: 口 stays small and stands on its own as the mouth, while 囗 is drawn large enough to wrap around other parts and always has something inside it.

kunigamae.mnemonic_text: This radical is a big closed square, like four walls with no door. You walk all the way around and find no way out. It is an <radical form="囗">enclosure</radical>.
kunigamae.image_prompt: Four solid walls form one big, unbroken square, with no door and no window. You could walk all the way around the walls and never find a way in or out. The closed square of walls is an <radical>enclosure</radical>.
kunigamae.description: 囗 is a closed square drawn big enough to surround whatever sits inside it. 冂 is the same frame with its bottom left open. 口 is the same closed square kept small, standing as a mouth rather than wrapping anything.

kuro.mnemonic_text: This radical is made of <part form="里">village</part> and <part form="灬">fire (bottom)</part>. A big <part form="灬">fire</part> burns under a small <part form="里">village</part>. The smoke turns every house <radical form="黒">black</radical>.
kuro.image_prompt: A small village of houses with fields sits in the upper part of the picture. Right below it, four big flames of a fire burn. Thick smoke rises through the village, and every house and roof is covered in soot, completely <radical>black</radical>.

kuruma.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a cart seen from above. The box is the body, the long line is the axle, and the flat bars are the wheels. It is a <radical form="車">vehicle</radical>.
kuruma.image_prompt: A wooden cart seen from directly above. A box in the middle is the body of the cart. A long line runs down through it as the axle. Horizontal bars stick out at the top and bottom as the wheels. It is a simple <radical>vehicle</radical>.

kusakanmuri.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like one flat line of soil with two small clumps poking up through it. That is a fresh patch of <radical form="艹">grass</radical>.
kusakanmuri.image_prompt: Two small clumps of green blades poke up side by side, each crossing one flat horizontal line that is the soil they sprout from. Seen from the side, it is a fresh little patch of <radical>grass</radical>.

lad.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a young man standing under a rock ledge. Three neat lines of combed hair fall down the side of his head. He is a proud young <radical form="彦">lad</radical>.
lad.image_prompt: A young man stands under an overhanging rock ledge, posing with his chest out. Three neat combed strokes of hair stream down the side of his head; his hair has clearly been styled with care. He is a proud young <radical>lad</radical>.

left-hand-2.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a giant foam hand from a sports game. The short line is the thumb, and the long line flops down to the left. It is a <radical form="𠂇">left hand</radical>.
left-hand-2.image_prompt: An oversized foam fan hand from a stadium, shaped as a left hand. A short stroke across the top is the stubby thumb sticking out sideways. One long stroke sweeps down to the lower left, the palm and wrist flopping over. It sits alone on empty bleachers: a <radical>left hand</radical>.

left-side.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like half of a log split down the middle. Three broken branches stick out to the left. It is the <radical form="爿">left-side kata</radical>.
left-side.image_prompt: A log split cleanly down the middle. A person holds up the left half. Three short, snapped branch stumps stick out to the left, and the flat split side runs straight down on the right. That half piece is the <radical>left-side kata</radical>.

life.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like three layers of soil with one green shoot pushing straight up through all of them. That little plant breaking out of the ground is new <radical form="生">life</radical>.
life.image_prompt: A side cut-away view of the ground. Three horizontal layers of packed brown soil are stacked one above the other. One green shoot pushes straight up through all three layers and breaks out of the top surface, two tiny leaves just opening. A fresh sprout of new <radical>life</radical>.

lightning.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a grey box on a pole. From its bottom, a crooked tail shoots down and hits a garden gnome. It is <radical form="电">lightning</radical>.
lightning.image_prompt: A boxy grey electric box high on a pole, a rectangle with one line across its middle. From the center of its base a line drops down, then bends sharply sideways into a jagged hook. The hook zaps a small garden gnome in a flowerbed, sparks flying. Stormy sky. The crooked tail is <radical>lightning</radical>.

long-kimono.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a man in a tall hat and a red robe. The robe is so long that it spreads out across the floor. He wears a <radical form="袁">long kimono</radical>.
long-kimono.image_prompt: A small man with a surprised face wears a tall black hat with a wide brim. His red robe has a yellow belt and wide sleeves, and it falls far past his feet, spreading out across the floor on both sides. He wears a <radical>long kimono</radical>.

long-stride.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like one leg stretched far forward. The shoe slides across wet ground, then kicks up at the end. That is a <radical form="廴">long stride</radical>.
long-stride.image_prompt: A single leg stretched much too far forward, the sole of its shoe dragging low across wet pavement and then kicking up into a hook at the right end. The whole line is one leg frozen mid <radical>long stride</radical>, stretched further than any real step.

lord.mnemonic_text: This radical puts a <part form="亠">lid</part> on top of a <part form="王">king</part>. The <part form="王">king</part> wears a pot <part form="亠">lid</part> as a hat. Nobody laughs. He is still the <radical form="主">lord</radical> of the house.
lord.image_prompt: A king in a red robe sits on a throne in a grand hall, wearing a round metal pot lid on his head instead of a crown. Servants bow low in front of him with serious faces. He is still the <radical>lord</radical> of the house.

ma-hook.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like two strokes that meet in a sharp point that turns inward. Anything that slides past gets caught. It is a <radical form="マ">hook</radical>.
ma-hook.image_prompt: Two metal strokes: one slants in from the left, and a second cuts back under it to a sharp point that turns inward like a small beak. A sock on a clothes line has slid past it and is now caught on the sharp point of the <radical>hook</radical>.

madare.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a roof built into the side of a cliff. The dot is the top of the rock, and the roof slopes down over open air with no floor. It is a small <radical form="广">shelter</radical>.
madare.image_prompt: A tall rock cliff. A single dot marks the clifftop, a short beam sticks out from the rock, and a wide roof sweeps down diagonally over open air. It is a lean-to nailed straight into the rock face, with nothing underneath for a floor: a small <radical>shelter</radical>.
madare.description: 广 is a bare lean-to: dot, beam, sweeping eave, open underneath. 疒 draws the same roof but adds two extra strokes tucked inside, like something lying under the eave. 尸 drops the dot and folds into one bent stroke, like a seated figure's back and leg — no roof.

mannaka.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a wooden shield: one long plank with two boards nailed across it. It sat in the sun so long that it is cracked and <radical form="干">dry</radical>.
mannaka.image_prompt: A wooden shield made of one long vertical plank with two crossbars nailed across it, the top one longer. It lies out in hot, bright sun until the wood is pale, cracked and completely <radical>dry</radical>.
mannaka.description: Look at the top stroke and count the bars. 干 starts with a flat horizontal and has two of them. 千 starts with a slanting flick and keeps only one bar beneath it. 牛 also starts with a flick but keeps two bars, the upper one short and pushed left.

market.mnemonic_text: This radical combines a <part form="亠">lid</part> and <part form="巾">cloth</part>. A <part form="亠">lid</part> of a roof covers <part form="巾">cloth</part> hanging for sale below. A street full of stalls like this is a <radical form="市">market</radical>.
market.image_prompt: A small flat roof like a lid sits at the top of a stall. Below it, colourful pieces of cloth hang down for sale, and more stalls like it run down the street. Shoppers crowd around the busy <radical>market</radical>.

mata.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a right hand reaching into a cookie jar. The lid shuts, and the same hand comes back <radical form="又">again</radical>.
mata.image_prompt: A right hand reaches into a cookie jar. The hooked stroke at the top is the bent knuckles, and the long stroke is the arm stretching down. The jar lid has just shut, and the same right hand slides back in <radical>again</radical>.

me.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like an eye turned on its side. The box is the eyelid, and the two lines inside are the pupil. It is an <radical form="目">eye</radical> staring back at you.
me.image_prompt: An eye turned upright on its end: the tall outer box is the eyelid framing everything, and the two lines inside hold the pupil between them, staring straight back at the viewer. One vertical <radical>eye</radical>.
me.description: Count what is inside the box. 目 is tall with two horizontal bars. 日 has one. 田 has one horizontal and one vertical crossing into a full grid.

measuring-box.mnemonic_text: This radical puts together a <part form="丿">slash</part> and <part form="廾">two hands</part>. <part form="廾">Two hands</part> hold a wooden box full of rice. A stick makes one <part form="丿">slash</part> across the top to level it. Now it is a <radical form="升">measuring box</radical>.
measuring-box.image_prompt: Two hands hold a small square wooden box heaped with rice. A flat stick sweeps in one diagonal slash across the top, knocking the extra rice off so it is exactly level. Loose grains fall onto the table. It is a <radical>measuring box</radical>.

men-exempt.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a person squeezing out from under a heavy lid, head bent, legs kicking. Everyone else stays stuck under it. This one walks away free. He is <radical form="免">exempt</radical>.
men-exempt.image_prompt: A heavy lid presses down on a crowd of people. One person squeezes out from under it: head bent, body pressed thin, two legs kicking free at the bottom. The others are still stuck under the lid. This one walks off, <radical>exempt</radical>.

men-face.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a mask on a wall. The outer box is the flat face, and the small box in the middle has holes for eyes. It hides whoever is behind it. That is a <radical form="面">mask</radical>.
men-face.image_prompt: A flat wooden mask hangs on a wall. Its outer frame is the face, and a smaller box in the middle has a bar across it with two eye holes cut in. You cannot see who is behind the <radical>mask</radical>.

mi-body.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a person seen from the side. A head is on top, a thick chest is in the middle, and the legs swing down below. It is a whole <radical form="身">body</radical>.
mi-body.image_prompt: A person drawn from the side: a small head at the top, a thick torso pushed out through the middle, and one long stroke swinging down and away underneath for the legs. The whole shape shows the full <radical>body</radical>, standing proud.

mimi.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like the side of a head. The tall frame is the outer rim, and the lines inside are the folds. It is an <radical form="耳">ear</radical>.
mimi.image_prompt: The side of someone's head: a tall outer frame is the ear's outer rim, and a stack of horizontal lines inside are the ridges and folds curving down into the canal. A whole <radical>ear</radical> stood up on the page.

mingle.mnemonic_text: This radical combines <part form="亠">lid</part> and <part form="父">father</part>. A party tent has a flat roof like a <part form="亠">lid</part>. Under it, a <part form="父">father</part> walks around and chats with every guest. He loves to <radical form="交">mingle</radical>.
mingle.image_prompt: A garden party. At the top, a party tent has a flat roof shaped like a lid on one short post. Under it, a cheerful father in a sweater walks between the guests, shaking one hand and waving at another, with a drink in his other hand. Everyone is talking. He loves to <radical>mingle</radical>.

miru.mnemonic_text: This radical is made of an <part form="目">eye</part> and <part form="儿">human legs</part>. A big <part form="目">eye</part> walks around your room on wobbly <part form="儿">human legs</part>. It stops to <radical form="見">see</radical> everything.
miru.image_prompt: A big round eyeball sits at the top, standing on two thin wobbly human legs. It walks across a bedroom, stops at a shelf, and leans in close to <radical>see</radical> everything on it.
miru.description: Both are a box standing on two legs. 見 ends with a straight left leg and a right leg that swings out and hooks upward. 貝 ends with two short straight strokes falling away like little feet.

mizu.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a stream falling straight down, with small splashes flying out to each side. That splash is <radical form="水">water</radical>.
mizu.image_prompt: A single stream runs straight down the middle, and two smaller trickles splash out to either side at the moment a drop hits the surface and sprays outward. The splash is frozen in mid-air: <radical>water</radical>.

mizukara.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a tall nose with lines across it. In Japan, people point at their own nose to say "me". That nose means <radical form="自">self</radical>.
mizukara.image_prompt: A tall narrow nose, drawn as a box with three lines stacked across it, sits on a smiling face. The person lifts one finger and points straight at their own nose, asking who, me? The nose stands for the <radical>self</radical>.

mochiiru.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a tall wooden rack split into little boxes. Each box holds a tool. You pick one up and put it to <radical form="用">use</radical>.
mochiiru.image_prompt: A tall wooden frame with two uprights running through it and two bars across the middle, dividing it into small compartments. Each compartment holds a workshop tool, and a hand is reaching in to take a hammer out to <radical>use</radical> it.

shinnyou.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a long road that sweeps out along the bottom, with two footsteps above it. You step onto the road and <radical form="辶">advance</radical>.
shinnyou.image_prompt: A long, flat road sweeps across the bottom of the scene from left to right and kicks up a little at the far end. Above the start of the road are two footprints, one after the other, as a traveller steps onto it. The traveller walks forward along the road to <radical>advance</radical>.

shiro.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a drop of milk with a small spark of light on top. The spark is the short stroke. The drop is bright, pure <radical form="白">white</radical>.
shiro.image_prompt: A single drop of milk shaped like a tall box, with a tiny slanted spark of light flicking off its top where it catches the sun. The small stroke above the box is that shine. The whole drop glows the brightest, purest <radical>white</radical>.
shiro.description: 白 is 日 with one extra stroke: a small flick sitting on top of the box. Everything below it is identical, so that little cap is the only thing to check.

shita.mnemonic_text: This radical combines <part form="千">thousand</part> and <part form="口">mouth</part>. A doctor sees a <part form="千">thousand</part> patients, and each one opens a wide <part form="口">mouth</part> and sticks out a long <radical form="舌">tongue</radical> to say ahh.
shita.image_prompt: A wide open mouth at the bottom of the scene. A long pink <radical>tongue</radical> sticks straight up out of it. A flat wooden stick lies across the tongue, and a small torch leans on its top. Flat cartoon style.

shou.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like one tiny seed in the middle, with a hand pinching in from each side. The hands show how <radical form="小">small</radical> it is.
shou.image_prompt: A single tiny seed sits in the centre as a short vertical stroke. Two little hands pinch in toward it from the left and the right, fingers almost touching, showing off just how <radical>small</radical> it is.

shou-esteem.mnemonic_text: This radical combines <part form="小">small</part> and <part form="冋">prairie</part>. A <part form="小">small</part> shrine stands alone on a wide <part form="冋">prairie</part>. People hold it in high <radical form="尚">esteem</radical>.
shou-esteem.image_prompt: At the top, a small shrine with a flared roof. Below it, a wide flat prairie of grass stretches in every direction, fenced by a simple frame. Travellers walk toward the shrine and bow to it, holding it in <radical>esteem</radical>.

single-item.mnemonic_text: A peaked top with two legs dropping straight down, and nothing at all underneath it. One tent, one pole, and no second of anything anywhere in the shape. It is how you point at exactly one thing and no more: a <radical>single item</radical>.
single-item.image_prompt: A peaked top with two legs dropping straight down, and nothing at all underneath it. One tent, one pole, and no second of anything anywhere in the shape. It is how you point at exactly one thing and no more: a <radical>single item</radical>.

sit.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like two little people side by side on a mound of dirt. The movers wait by the truck, but the two will not get up. They just <radical form="坐">sit</radical>.
sit.image_prompt: Two identical tiny figures sit side by side, cross-legged and blank-faced, on a low mound of packed earth with a flat top line. Behind them a loaded moving truck waits and two movers stand with their arms crossed. Flat dry daylight. The pair refuse to move; they just <radical>sit</radical>.

slash.mnemonic_text: This radical is one line from top right to bottom left, like a single ski track on a white mountain. One skier made one <radical form="丿">slash</radical>.
slash.image_prompt: A single diagonal stroke crosses the frame from upper right to lower left, wide at the start and thin at the end with a small flick. It is a lone ski track in deep snow on a smooth white mountain. A small skier stands at the bottom, looking back at the <radical>slash</radical>.

snout.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like three short lines closed off on one side, like a nose with ridges. An animal pushes it through the bushes. That nose is a <radical form="⺕">snout</radical>.
snout.image_prompt: Three short horizontal bars are stacked and joined by a vertical stroke on the right, forming the blunt, ridged front of an animal's nose. The nose pushes forward through thick bushes, with leaves stuck to it. That front end is a <radical>snout</radical>.

someone.mnemonic_text: This radical is made of <part form="耂">old</part> and <part form="日">sun / day</part>. An <part form="耂">old</part> man naps in the <part form="日">sun</part> on a park bench. You do not know his name. He is just <radical form="者">someone</radical>.
someone.image_prompt: In the upper half, an old man with a cane and a flat cap sits asleep on a park bench. Below him, a bright round sun shines warmly. Nobody in the park knows his name; he is just <radical>someone</radical>.

sound.mnemonic_text: This radical is made of <part form="立">stand</part> and <part form="日">sun</part>. A rooster likes to <part form="立">stand</part> on top of the rising <part form="日">sun</part> and crow. It makes a very loud <radical form="音">sound</radical>.
sound.image_prompt: A proud rooster stands tall at the top of the picture, its feet planted on the upper edge of a big rising sun below it. Its beak is wide open, crowing so hard that curved lines of <radical>sound</radical> ring out across the morning sky.

southeast.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like two people kneeling under one long table. Both peek out and look up at a corner of the sky. They look toward the <radical form="巽">southeast</radical>.
southeast.image_prompt: A long wooden table stands on two short legs. Under it, two people in yellow tops and blue trousers kneel on hands and knees, one at each end. Both peek out and look up toward a corner of the sky, the <radical>southeast</radical>.

sprout.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a bread roll on a counter. A green stem grows up through the middle, with two small leaves on each side. It is a <radical form="龶">sprout</radical>.
sprout.image_prompt: An old dinner roll on a kitchen counter. A single straight green stem grows up through the center of the crust. Two short horizontal pairs of leaves cross the stem, one high and one low. The crust splits along one line at the base where the stem comes out. The shape reads as a young <radical>sprout</radical>.

sprouting-stalk.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a small green stem pushing up through a board. At the top it splits into two leaves. It is a <radical form="𢆉">sprouting stalk</radical>.
sprouting-stalk.image_prompt: A flat wooden board lies across the bottom. A small green stem pushes up through a crack in the middle with a little soil around it. At the top, the stem splits into two round green leaves, one to each side. It is a <radical>sprouting stalk</radical>.

street.mnemonic_text: This radical combines <part form="一">ground</part> and <part form="亅">barb</part>. A flat <part form="一">ground</part> line is the main road. A side road drops from it and bends like a <part form="亅">barb</part>. It is a <radical form="丁">street</radical>.
street.image_prompt: A top-down map view of a T-junction. A long horizontal line across the top is the main road on flat ground. A narrower side road drops from its center and ends in a short hook curling left. A small delivery van has hit the kerb at the hook. It is a <radical>street</radical>.

style.mnemonic_text: This radical combines <part form="弋">stake</part> and <part form="工">construction</part>. A builder does <part form="工">construction</part> at a bench, and always ties his tool to the same <part form="弋">stake</part>. The same way every time is his <radical form="式">style</radical>.
style.image_prompt: A small wooden workbench stands on the left. On the right, a tall hooked stake leans against it, with a tool tied to it by a rope at the same fixed angle. The builder uses it the same way every time. That fixed way of working is a <radical>style</radical>.

substitute.mnemonic_text: This radical combines <part form="亻">person (left)</part> and <part form="弋">stake</part>. A <part form="亻">person (left)</part> steps aside, and a <part form="弋">stake</part> now stands in his spot to do his job. The stake is the <radical form="代">substitute</radical>.
substitute.image_prompt: On the left, a man in a uniform stands and looks sadly at the spot he just left, his footprints leading away from it. On the right, a tall wooden stake with a red ribbon stands in his place, doing his job. The stake is the <radical>substitute</radical>.

sun.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a flat wooden ruler with one small tick mark on it. A thumb holds the ruler down to measure exactly one <radical form="寸">inch</radical>.
sun.image_prompt: A carpenter's flat wooden ruler lies across the top, with a hooked upright hanging from it and one small tick mark beside the upright. A thumb presses on the tick mark to pin the ruler in place and measure exactly one <radical>inch</radical>.
sun.description: Both have a hooked vertical crossed by a bar. 寸 adds a single dot beside the vertical, on its left. 扌 has no dot; its last stroke is a flick rising from the lower left up through the vertical.

sunbeam.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a round sun on top with long rays below. All the rays lean the same way, like one bright stick of light. That is a <radical form="昜">sunbeam</radical>.
sunbeam.image_prompt: A round sun with two small eyes sits on top. Below it, many long rays stream down together at an angle, every one leaning the same way, forming one bright slanted column of light. That light is a <radical>sunbeam</radical>.

sunrise.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a square sun on a post, with a crank handle on top. A bored stagehand turns the handle, and the sun slowly climbs up the post. It is a stage <radical form="𠦝">sunrise</radical>.
sunrise.image_prompt: On a theatre stage, a small square box with one bar across it is painted as the sun. Below it a short cross makes a stubby post in the flat ground; above it another short cross is a hand-crank handle. A bored stagehand winds the handle, and the boxed sun ratchets up the post: a stage <radical>sunrise</radical>.

sweeper.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a broom standing up, with stiff bristles on top, a band, and a long handle. It has swept the rug, two chairs and even the lamp into one pile. It is a very good <radical form="帚">sweeper</radical>.
sweeper.image_prompt: A tall upright broom: three short stiff strokes splay out at the top as bristles, one tight band holds them at the neck, and a long straight handle drops below. It stands on a wide wooden floor beside one corner pile: a rolled rug, two fallen chairs and a floor lamp. A very good <radical>sweeper</radical>.

swim.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a flag on the left and a child on the right, both leaning with the water. The child kicks along under the flag to <radical form="斿">swim</radical>.
swim.image_prompt: A flag on a pole streams sideways on the left, pushed by a river current. On the right, a small child is under it in the water, leaning the same way as the current and kicking hard to <radical>swim</radical> along with the flow.

ta.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a field seen from above. Two paths cross in the middle and cut it into four squares. Those green squares are a <radical form="田">rice field</radical>.
ta.image_prompt: Seen from above, a big square of farmland. Two narrow dirt paths cross in the middle, cutting it into four neat green squares of flooded young rice. A farmer stands at the edge of the <radical>rice field</radical>.
ta.description: 田 is the only one of the three with a vertical inside the box, splitting it into four. 日 has a single horizontal bar and 目 has two, but neither is ever divided down the middle.

takai.mnemonic_text: This radical combines <part form="亠">lid</part>, <part form="口">mouth</part> and <part form="冋">prairie</part>. A tower stands on a wide <part form="冋">prairie</part>. It has a <part form="亠">lid</part> for a roof and a window shaped like a <part form="口">mouth</part>. It is very <radical form="高">tall</radical>.
takai.image_prompt: A slender tower stands alone on a wide, flat prairie of grass. A pointed lid sits on top as its roof. Just below the roof is one square window shaped like an open mouth. Wider rooms stack below it, and the tower rises into the clouds, very <radical>tall</radical>.

takekanmuri.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like two tall green stalks side by side. Each stalk has one leaf sticking out. Two stalks with leaves are <radical form="竹">bamboo</radical>.
takekanmuri.image_prompt: Two straight green stalks stand side by side, each split into segments by rings. The left stalk has one leaf pointing out to the left, and the right stalk has one leaf pointing out to the right. The two stalks are <radical>bamboo</radical>.

tanned-leather.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like two feet pulling one animal skin from both ends. They pull and work it until it is flat and soft. The skin becomes <radical form="韋">tanned leather</radical>.
tanned-leather.image_prompt: An animal hide is stretched flat in the middle of the picture. One foot at the top and one foot at the bottom step in opposite directions, pulling the hide tight from both ends. The hide has turned smooth and brown: <radical>tanned leather</radical>.

tatsu.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a person on a wide flat floor. The dot is the head, the two short lines are arms out for balance, and the long line is the ground. They <radical form="立">stand</radical> tall.
tatsu.image_prompt: A simple figure on a wide flat platform. The top dot is the head, two short slanted strokes below it are arms thrown out for balance, and the long bottom line is the solid ground under their feet. The figure is upright and steady, ready to <radical>stand</radical>.

te.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like an open hand. The long line runs up from the wrist through the palm. The three flat lines are spread fingers. It is a <radical form="手">hand</radical>.
te.image_prompt: A wrist at the bottom with one long vertical stroke running up through the palm, while three horizontal strokes fan out sideways like fingers spread wide. We look straight at an open <radical>hand</radical>.

tehen.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like an arm with three short fingers sticking out to the side. It sits on the left of a kanji and grabs what is next to it. It is a <radical form="扌">hand (left)</radical>.
tehen.image_prompt: A vertical arm with a hook at the bottom stands at the left edge. Three short strokes branch off to the side like a thumb and fingers curling out, reaching right to grab whatever comes next. It is a <radical>hand (left)</radical>.
tehen.description: Both are built on a hooked vertical. 扌 ends with a flick rising from the lower left into that vertical and never carries a dot. 寸 is the reverse: no rising flick, one clear dot set to the right of the hook.

ten.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like one tiny slanted mark. It is a single bead of water, sliding off the tip of a leaf. That one little stroke is a <radical form="丶">drop</radical>.
ten.image_prompt: A single small bead of water hangs in the air, caught the moment it slides off the pointed tip of a green leaf. It is slanted a little as it falls, one clear <radical>drop</radical>.

ten-thousand.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a ticket machine at a deli. The top line is its lid. The long stroke is one ticket rolling to the floor. The number on it is <radical form="万">ten thousand</radical>.
ten-thousand.image_prompt: The top horizontal stroke is the flat lid of a deli ticket machine. Below it, a short stroke and a hook form the machine's boxy body. The long final stroke sweeps down to the lower left as one paper ticket rolling across the floor, with the number <radical>ten thousand</radical> printed on it.

the-latter.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a swan with a long bent neck. It stands on the lower step of a podium, biting a silver medal. It came <radical form="乙">second</radical>.
the-latter.image_prompt: One curved stroke forms a swan seen from the side: a short top stroke for the head, a long S-curve for the neck and body, and a small upward hook for the tail. It stands on the lower step of a podium, biting a big silver medal stamped 2. It came <radical>second</radical>.

thicket.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like many thin young trees pressed close together. Two lines tie them tight, and roots spread at the bottom. They make a thick <radical form="菐">thicket</radical>.
thicket.image_prompt: At the top, a tight row of thin young tree trunks stand pressed close together. Two horizontal strokes cross them like wire tying the trunks tight. At the bottom, the last two strokes spread out as roots in a mound of dirt. The trees form a dense <radical>thicket</radical>.

third-class.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a plain box with a flat roof. Inside, one tired passenger sits on a hard wooden bench. No window, no cushion. This is <radical form="丙">third class</radical>.
third-class.image_prompt: Cross-section of an old train compartment shaped like a plain box: one flat roof beam across the top, two straight walls down to the floor. Inside, a tired passenger sits on a hard wooden bench, knees apart. Bare bulb, no window, peeling paint: <radical>third class</radical>.

thousand.mnemonic_text: This radical is made of a <part form="丿">slash</part> and <part form="十">ten</part>. A quick <part form="丿">slash</part> on top of a <part form="十">ten</part> makes it much bigger. Ten becomes a <radical form="千">thousand</radical>.
thousand.image_prompt: A big number ten stands on a price tag. A pen draws one short slash across its top, and the price suddenly jumps. A shocked shopper looks at the new price: one <radical>thousand</radical>.

three.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like three claw marks down a fence post. Each mark is a little shorter than the one above it. Count the marks: <radical form="彡">three</radical>.
three.image_prompt: A wooden fence post with three diagonal claw marks scratched into it, from top to bottom. Each mark is a little shorter than the one above. A small, proud cat sits beside the post, one paw raised, having just made all <radical>three</radical>.

three-and.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like three bars stacked up, with a big person pushing up through all of them. Count the bars and look at the person: <radical form="𡗗">three and big</radical>.
three-and.image_prompt: Three horizontal bars are stacked one above the other. A big figure with arms spread wide pushes up through the middle of all three bars at once, straining. Three bars and one big body: <radical>three and big</radical>.

to-dipper.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a long ladle full of flour, with two bits of flour flying off. A tiny baker holds its long handle. He measures flour with this <radical form="斗">dipper</radical>.
to-dipper.image_prompt: A big grey ladle lies across the picture, its scoop on the left heaped with white flour. A long grey handle stands straight up across it, and a tiny smiling baker in a white cap and blue apron holds its top. Two bits of flour fly off to the upper left. It is a measuring <radical>dipper</radical>.

tobira.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a wooden door frame. The short stroke on top is a loose piece of the door. A raccoon pushes through underneath. It is a <radical form="戸">door</radical>.
tobira.image_prompt: A wooden door frame: a flat top beam with a short loose board tilted on top of it, a long bent post on the left and a short post on the right. A raccoon pushes its way through the opening underneath. This is a <radical>door</radical>.
tobira.description: 尸 is the same bent frame without that extra stroke — just a horizontal roof over a long hooking body line, like a slumped figure with nothing above it. 戸 adds the short diagonal tick at the top-left corner, the door panel catching on its hinge, which 尸 never has.

tomeru.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a roadblock barricade. A long beam lies along the bottom, a tall post rises from it with one short arm sticking out to the side, and a shorter post stands at the far end. Its red and white stripes tell every walker to <radical form="止">stop</radical>.
tomeru.image_prompt: A striped roadwork barricade seen from the front. A long beam lies along the bottom on two stubby feet. A tall post rises from left of centre with one short arm sticking out to the right halfway up, and a second, shorter post stands at the right end, separate from the first. The red and white stripes mean <radical>stop</radical>.

tool.mnemonic_text: This radical combines <part form="目">eye</part>, <part form="一">ground</part> and <part form="八">split</part>. An <part form="目">eye</part> looks through a telescope. It stands on the <part form="一">ground</part> on legs <part form="八">split</part> wide apart. It is a useful <radical form="具">tool</radical>.
tool.image_prompt: A telescope with a big eye looking through it at the top. It sits on a flat bar on the ground, held up by two legs split wide apart. The eye stays steady and the hands stay free. A handy <radical>tool</radical>.

tooth.mnemonic_text: This radical combines <part form="止">stop</part>, <part form="米">rice</part> and <part form="凵">open box</part>. The jaw is an <part form="凵">open box</part>. Tight rows of teeth <part form="止">stop</part> a grain of <part form="米">rice</part>. Each one is a <radical form="歯">tooth</radical>.
tooth.image_prompt: A jaw seen from the front, open wide like a box. Rows of small square teeth sit tight in the gum line. One grain of rice is stuck on top, because the teeth are so close together that it cannot slip through. Each small square is a <radical>tooth</radical>.

tori-bird.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a pigeon on a windowsill. Its head is tucked in at the top. Four thin legs stick out below and tap on the glass. It is a clumsy <radical form="鳥">bird</radical>.
tori-bird.image_prompt: A pigeon with its head ducked into a hunched wing lands stiffly on a windowsill. Under its body, four skinny stick legs splay out and clatter against the glass. The whole awkward, top-heavy shape is a <radical>bird</radical>.

tsuchi.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a wooden signpost stuck in the ground. The long line at the bottom is the flat ground it stands in. That ground is <radical form="土">earth</radical>.
tsuchi.image_prompt: A wooden signpost is hammered into the ground, its post crossed by one short board. The long horizontal line at the bottom is the flat ground it is planted in. The post stands in the soil, marking a patch of <radical>earth</radical>.

tsuki.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a tall window with two bars across it. At night you press your face to the glass and see the <radical form="月">moon</radical>.
tsuki.image_prompt: A tall, narrow window with two bars across the middle. It is night. A person presses their face to the glass, and framed perfectly inside the window hangs a bright crescent <radical>moon</radical>.

tsukue.mnemonic_text: This radical has a flat top, a straight leg on the left, and a right leg that bends out at the foot. It is a small <radical form="几">table</radical>. It leans so much that the teacup slides off.
tsukue.image_prompt: A low side table seen from the front. The top is one short flat stroke. The left leg falls straight to the floor. The right leg comes across, then bends down and out into a small foot. The table leans, and a teacup slides off it mid-fall. One wobbling <radical>table</radical>.

tsume.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a hand reaching down from a bar, with three bent fingers and sharp black nails. It is a <radical form="爪">claw</radical>.
tsume.image_prompt: A flat tan bar runs across the top. From under it, a hand reaches down, palm down, with three long bent fingers curling in. Each finger ends in a sharp curved black nail, ready to grab from above. It is a <radical>claw</radical>.

tsutsumu.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a hooked stroke curling around something. A too-small sheet of paper curls over a big watermelon. It barely covers it, but it is still a <radical form="勹">wrap</radical>.
tsutsumu.image_prompt: A curved, hooked sheet of gift paper curls over the top and down the right side of a large watermelon on a counter. The sheet is much too small, so one edge only just overlaps. The lopsided parcel is still a <radical>wrap</radical>.

twenty.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like two long icicles hanging from one branch. Each icicle drips ten drops. Ten and ten make <radical form="廿">twenty</radical>.
twenty.image_prompt: A brown branch lies across the top. Two long pale blue icicles hang down from it, side by side, with snow on top where they meet the branch. Drops of water fall from the tips. Two icicles of ten drops each make <radical>twenty</radical>.

ukanmuri.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a dot on top of a wide line with sides that slope down. The dot is a chimney. A pigeon slides down the slope of the <radical form="宀">roof</radical>.
ukanmuri.image_prompt: A single dot on top is a chimney. Below it, a flat line spreads wide with both edges dropping down as eaves. A pigeon has landed on the chimney, lost its balance, and is sliding on its belly down the slope of the <radical>roof</radical>.

ukebako.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a box with two walls and a floor, but no top. Anything you drop in from above lands inside and stays there. It is an <radical form="凵">open box</radical>.
ukebako.image_prompt: A simple box seen from the front: two upright walls joined by a flat floor, and nothing at all across the top. Small balls fall in from above and land inside, staying put. There is no lid. It is an <radical>open box</radical> with its mouth turned to the sky.

uma.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like an animal seen from the side. The box on top is the head and body, and the four dots below are legs running fast. It is a <radical form="馬">horse</radical>.
uma.image_prompt: An animal seen from the side, drawn with boxy shapes. The block at the top is the head and mane, and the body sits below it. Four little legs dash along the bottom, kicking up dust as it gallops. It is a <radical>horse</radical>.

uo.mnemonic_text: This radical is made of <part form="𠂊">crouch</part>, <part form="田">rice field</part> and <part form="灬">fire (bottom)</part>. A man <part form="𠂊">crouches</part> in a wet <part form="田">rice field</part> and grabs his dinner. He cooks it over a <part form="灬">fire</part>. It is a <radical form="魚">fish</radical>.
uo.image_prompt: At the top, a man crouches low at the edge of a flooded rice field, grabbing a wriggling fish from the water. The square rice field fills the middle. At the bottom, a small campfire with four flames grills the <radical>fish</radical> on a stick.

ushi.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like an animal seen from the front. The slanted top stroke is one horn, and the two bars below are its shoulders and back. It is a <radical form="牛">cow</radical>.
ushi.image_prompt: An animal seen from the front. A slanted stroke on top is a single horn tilting on its head. Two horizontal bars below are its strong shoulders and back, with a vertical line through the middle as its body. It is a <radical>cow</radical>.
ushi.description: All three are bars crossed by a vertical. 干 starts flat, with no slash on top. 牛 and 午 both start with a slanting flick, but 牛's vertical pushes up above the upper bar while 午's stops at it.

using.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like wooden tongs on the left and a happy person on the right. The person grabs the tongs and starts <radical form="以">using</radical> them.
using.image_prompt: On the left, a pair of wooden tongs, two long sticks tied together at the left end, points to the right. On the right, a smiling yellow stick person reaches up and grabs the end of the top stick, with small spark lines. The person is <radical>using</radical> the tongs.

valley.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like two hills that slope down toward each other. Below them is a narrow opening where a river runs out. That is a <radical form="谷">valley</radical>.
valley.image_prompt: Two hills slope down from the sides toward each other, making a V shape. At the bottom of the V there is a narrow, boxy opening, and a small river runs out of it. A hiker stands at the edge, looking down into the <radical>valley</radical>.

wakanmuri.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a blanket thrown over a sleeping cat. The flat top lies across, and the two short sides tuck in the edges. Nothing pokes out. It is a <radical form="冖">cover</radical>.
wakanmuri.image_prompt: A cat curled up asleep on a wooden porch, completely hidden under a thrown blanket. The blanket lies flat across the top, and its two ends droop down only a little on each side, just enough to tuck in the edges. Not even the tail pokes out. A snug <radical>cover</radical>.
wakanmuri.description: 冂 is tall and open — its two vertical sides run most of the character's height, like a doorway frame with nothing under it. 冖's sides are short, barely drooping below the top stroke at all, more lid than frame.

walled-path.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a long stone path with walls on both sides and two gates across it. A small snail walks down this <radical form="甬">walled path</radical>.
walled-path.image_prompt: Seen from above, a long narrow path of grey stepping stones runs from top to bottom. Stone walls close it in on the left, right and top, and two wooden gates cross it. A lamp hangs at the top right corner, and a small snail walks down the <radical>walled path</radical>.

warifu.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a man kneeling low, with a small flag at the top. He presses a wooden block into the soft ground. He is making a <radical form="卩">stamp</radical>.
warifu.image_prompt: An official in a long blue robe and blue cap kneels and bows low. A small yellow flag on a thin pole stands at the top left. With both hands he presses a carved wooden block down into soft brown ground, making a <radical>stamp</radical>.

well.mnemonic_text: This radical combines <part form="二">two</part> and <part form="廾">two hands</part>. <part form="二">Two</part> wooden beams lie across a deep hole. <part form="廾">Two hands</part> grip them to pull up a bucket from the <radical form="井">well</radical>.
well.image_prompt: Seen from above: two long wooden beams lie flat across the round opening of a deep stone hole. Two hands reach down and grip the beams on each side, pulling a rope with a full bucket of water up from the <radical>well</radical>.

west.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a window with a fat sun stuck inside. The sun kicks its two little legs as it tries to set in the <radical form="西">west</radical>.
west.image_prompt: A square window frame: a flat line on top, two sides, and a hooked stroke closing the bottom. A fat orange sun is jammed inside, trying to sink. Its two stubby legs, the two short strokes inside, kick against the frame as it tries to set in the <radical>west</radical>.

wind.mnemonic_text: This radical combines <part form="几">table</part>, <part form="丿">slash</part> and <part form="虫">insect</part>. An <part form="虫">insect</part> hides under a <part form="几">table</part>. A strong gust hits in one quick <part form="丿">slash</part>. It is the <radical form="風">wind</radical>.
wind.image_prompt: A small table stands outdoors. A beetle hides underneath, gripping the floor with all six legs. A strong gust cuts across the top of the table in one diagonal slash, blowing leaves past. The beetle holds on against the <radical>wind</radical>.

winter.mnemonic_text: This radical is made of a <part form="夂">trailing foot</part> and <part form="冫">ice</part>. A <part form="夂">trailing foot</part> drags slowly over two patches of <part form="冫">ice</part>. Slow, cold steps like these mean <radical form="冬">winter</radical>.
winter.image_prompt: A tired foot in a thick boot drags slowly across the top of the picture. Under it are two small patches of slippery ice on the ground. Snow falls around it on a grey <radical>winter</radical> day, and the foot is about to slip.

ya.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like an arrow. The short strokes at the top are feathers, and the lines at the bottom are the sharp point. It is stuck in a pumpkin. A stray <radical form="矢">arrow</radical>!
ya.image_prompt: At a fair, an arrow has missed the target. Two short strokes at the top are feathers on the shaft, the line drops straight down, then splits into a sharp point. The point pins a vendor's pumpkin to a fence, still shaking. A stray <radical>arrow</radical>.

yamahen.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like three peaks rising from flat ground. The tall peak in the middle is the top of a <radical form="山">mountain</radical>.
yamahen.image_prompt: Three peaks rise from one flat ground line: a tall peak in the middle with a shorter peak on each side. Seen straight on, together they form the jagged outline of a <radical>mountain</radical> against a clear blue sky.

yamaidare.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a slanted roof with two small marks by the wall. Under the roof, a man shakes so hard that his thermometer snaps in two. This house is full of <radical form="疒">sickness</radical>.
yamaidare.image_prompt: A small house drawn with a dot on top, a long flat roof, and a wall slanting down on the left, with two short tick marks beside that wall. Under the roof, a pale man in a blanket shivers so hard that the thermometer in his hand snaps in two. The whole room shows <radical>sickness</radical>.
yamaidare.description: Both have a dot over a long roof and a wall slanting down on the left. This radical adds two short ticks on the left side of that wall. 广 (cliff / shelter) has no ticks.

yellow.mnemonic_text: This radical puts together <part form="龷">twin sprouts</part>, <part form="由">reason</part> and <part form="八">split</part>. <part form="龷">Twin sprouts</part> grow on a lamp. Its light is the <part form="由">reason</part> they grow. It stands on <part form="八">split</part> legs and glows <radical form="黄">yellow</radical>.
yellow.image_prompt: An old oil lamp stands on a shelf. Two small green sprouts grow out of its flat cap, reaching toward the light. The square glass body holds a burning wick, and the lamp stands on two legs that split apart below. The glass glows a warm <radical>yellow</radical>.

yumi.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a strip of wood that bends back and forth. Tie a string from top to bottom, pull it tight, and you are holding a <radical form="弓">bow</radical>.
yumi.image_prompt: A strip of springy wood bends back and forth in stacked curves, seen from the side, with a notch at the top and bottom where the string hooks on. A tight string runs between the notches. It is a <radical>bow</radical>.

yuu-evening.mnemonic_text: This radical looks like a thin crescent moon with a small cloud passing across it. When the moon comes out, it is <radical form="夕">evening</radical>.
yuu-evening.image_prompt: A curve leans in from the top and folds back like a thin crescent moon, and one short stroke slips through the middle like a drifting cloud. A hedgehog on a balcony holds a fork up to the moon, sure someone takes a bite of it every <radical>evening</radical>.
